claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which requires activationCost + UseCountResource + resetCadence. Both Defy Death (always-on passive) and Heroic Rally (automatic turn-start trigger, no cost, no use count) cannot be honestly expressed as 'activated' features. A new family is needed for passive/automatic class feature effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Defy Death: 'You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.' (no action, no limit). Heroic Rally: 'At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points...' (automatic, conditioned on state, no activation).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount — flat_plus_ability_mod variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Rally heals '5 plus your Constitution modifier'. DiceAmount only supports dice-based expressions with static flat bonuses; it has no way to express a dynamic ability modifier addend. A new variant like {kind: 'flat_plus_ability_mod', flat: number, ability: Ability} is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Heroic Rally: 'you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier'

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RollKind — death_saving_throw
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Defy Death grants Advantage specifically on Death Saving Throws, which are mechanically distinct from ordinary saving throws (no ability modifier, automatic outcomes at 1/20, three-failure death). Current RollKind is 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' with no death-save distinction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Defy Death: 'You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.'

claude_proposed_widenings.name: conditional trigger predicate (Bloodied + HP > 0)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Rally fires only when the character is Bloodied (HP ≤ half max) AND has at least 1 HP. No current surface type models a conditional predicate on HP state that gates an automatic effect. This is a new kind of trigger condition not present in any existing family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Heroic Rally: 'if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point'

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_threshold (death save 18–20 → 20)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Defy Death's second clause widens the automatic-success threshold on Death Saving Throws from 20 to 18–20. v4 has no atom for 'treat rolls ≥ N as the maximum result' on a specific roll type. This is mechanically distinct from modify_roll_advantage and from the existing crit-window pressure noted in v4 §12.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Defy Death: 'when you roll 18–20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.'
